extends Node
var p
var steps := 0
func _ready() -> void:
	p = get_meta("viento_project")
	set_process(false)
	call_deferred("_start")
func _start() -> void:
	var host = p.host.get_ref()
	host.set_process(false)
	host.flush_requests()
	if host.visit_index == 1:
		p.publish_event("action", true)
		host.flush_requests()
		_step(0.5)
		p.request_scene("12345678-1234-4234-8234-123456789abd")
		return
	p.select_animation_clip("59595959-5959-4595-8595-000000000011")
	p.play_animation()
	host.flush_requests()
	set_process(true)
func _step(seconds: float) -> void:
	var host = p.host.get_ref()
	host.elapsed_seconds += seconds
	host.total_seconds += seconds
	host.current.project_step(seconds)
	host.flush_requests()
func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	steps += 1
	for key in ["tail.a", "tail.b", "tail.c", "tail.d"]:
		p.write_state(key, steps)
	if steps == 40:
		set_process(false)
		call_deferred("_finish")
func _finish() -> void:
	p.host.get_ref().finish_project()
